## Work

- [Beetle Eyes Clothing: website design and build](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/beetle-eyes.html): A one-page website for Beetle Eyes Clothing, Corrine Kaenzig's pre-loved and vintage rail inside Curious Magpie in Mountsorrel. Designed and built by John Bell.
- [Birdie Blooms: website and branding](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/birdie-blooms.html): A website and brand for Birdie Blooms, a one-woman flower studio in Ravenstone and Kibworth, Leicestershire, with seasonal colours. Designed and built by John Bell.
- [Birth-hood: website design and build](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/birth-hood.html): A warm, friendly website for birth-hood, a hypnobirthing, doula and yoga business in Leicestershire. Built by John Bell in Next.js, with Sanity for easy editing.
- [GoSweet: online sweet shop design and build](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/gosweet.html): My full design for the GoSweet online sweet shop: every page, clear product cards, a basket and rewards. Not the live shop.
- [Nic Pouches: online shop design and build](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/nic-pouches.html): My full design for the Nic Pouches online shop: strength at a glance, quick add to basket and Nic Points rewards. Not the live shop.
- [PATCH: brand identity and website](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/patch.html): The logo, brand roll-out, uniform, print and website for PATCH, a UK in-store sales and brand ambassador team. Designed and built by John Bell.
- [Brochure & Print Design · Birmingham & UK-wide](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/print.html): Brochure and print design by John Bell, a freelance designer in Birmingham working UK-wide: brochures, reports, newsletters, logos, displays and short films.
- [Property Marketing & Brochure Design](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/property.html): Print for housebuilders, developers and estate agents, from development logos to sales brochures, site boards, banners, flyers and adverts. Designed by John Bell.
- [SCCC Heritage: website design and build](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/sccc-heritage.html): A history website for Sutton Coldfield Cricket Club: nearly 180 years of archive photos and stories as a timeline. Designed and built by John Bell in React.
- [VSL Trade: website design and build](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/vsl-trade.html): A brand website for VSL Trade that shows convenience stores who they are, the range, the low prices and the service, then signs them up. By John Bell.
- [What’s in my Fridge: web app design and build](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/whats-in-my-fridge.html): What’s in my Fridge is John Bell’s own web app: snap your shopping or a receipt, see what to use first and get dinner ideas from what’s in. Built in React.

## Guides

- [How Long Does It Take to Build a Website?](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/how-long-does-a-website-take.html): How long a small business website takes to build, from about a week for a small site to four weeks or more for a shop, and how to get yours live sooner.
- [How Much Does a Logo Cost in the UK?](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/how-much-does-a-logo-cost.html): What a logo really costs a UK small business: logo makers, freelancers and agencies compared, what you should get, and when a cheap logo costs you more.
- [How Much Does a Website Cost? (UK 2026)](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/how-much-does-a-website-cost.html): What a small business website really costs in the UK in 2026: DIY, freelancer and agency prices, what changes the price, and the running costs after launch.
- [How to Get Your Small Business on Google](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/how-to-get-your-business-on-google.html): How to get your small business on Google and Google Maps: a free Business Profile, reviews, a proper website and local pages, in plain, practical steps.
- [Do I Need a Logo Before a Website?](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/logo-or-website-first.html): Should you get a logo before your website? When it matters, when it doesn’t, and why doing both together usually saves time and money.
- [Shopify or a Normal Website? Which to Choose](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/shopify-or-website.html): Do you need a Shopify shop or a normal website? A plain guide for small businesses: what each is for, what they cost, and how to choose.
- [What Should a Small Business Website Include?](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/what-should-a-small-business-website-include.html): What a small business website needs: the pages, a clear way to get in touch, reasons to trust you, speed on phones and the legal bits, in plain English.
- [Wix or Squarespace vs a Web Designer](https://jbdesignagency.co.uk/projects/wix-squarespace-or-web-designer.html): Should you build your own site on Wix or Squarespace, or hire a web designer? An honest look at the costs, the time and what suits a small business.
